data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'. [T-4914] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
